container noun

also storage, vessel (container), vessels

classical

vāsculum, vāsculī n.

noun, second declension

small container

Other words

  • vāsculum operculō clausum — container closed with a lid

    also used · our formation

    Our storage description; the complete covered-container phrase is ours.

  • vās, vāsis n. — vessel, container

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Ter. Heaut. 1.1.89: nec vās nec vestīmentum (Lewis & Short); Hor. Ep. 1.2.54: sincērum est nisi vās, quodcumque īnfundis acēscit (Lewis & Short)

    The general classical word for a vessel of any kind, with plural vāsa, vāsōrum (see dishes). Not to be confused with vas, vadis m., a surety.

See also lid, store, leftovers.
